scope: project-local design skills; no global installation or third-party script execution

reuse.consumer: Before applying local edits or upgrading either skill, compare local Git blob hashes to this pinned source inventory; mismatches distinguish local changes from upstream changes.
reuse.measurement: file count, missing/unexpected files and blob-hash mismatches
reuse.rebuild: Re-run the recorded installer with repo, subpath, commit, name and project-local destination; GitHub pinned commit remains the upstream source truth.
reuse.effectiveness: Integrity verified for this download; no measured improvement to a later design task is claimed.
